sections.title: Family Based Interventions
sections.description: This advanced-level course focuses on social work interentions with children, couples and families. Theories and research that ground family-based interventions are explored and interogated. Through case conceptualizations, role plays and other in-vivo exercises, students will practice techniques for assessment and treatment of family systems. Registration restricted to majors only.
